name: Glide
summary: AI app builder that turns spreadsheets, files or prompts into internal business apps and agents.
description: GlideOS builds custom, AI-powered business apps and agents from a spreadsheet, a prompt or a file; every app shares one connected data layer with workflows, integrations and role-based access, and publishes to desktop and mobile for employees, customers or partners. Glide Classic, the original no-code builder, offers 300+ app templates and its own API. Free plan with paid Basic, Plus, Pro and Enterprise tiers.
contains: GlideOS builds apps and agents from a prompt, spreadsheet or file
Free plan; Basic $25, Plus $50, Pro $125 per month; Enterprise on request
1,000+ integrations incl. Google Sheets, Excel, Airtable, QuickBooks, Salesforce, Snowflake
300+ app templates (540 total) for portals, dashboards, CRM, inventory and more
Publishes desktop and mobile apps with roles, SSO and row ownership
Bring-your-own-agent support and a Glide MCP server
